scope: Team run-wide step and retry budget authority

change.authority: persist_attempt_admissions is the only durable writer of Team steps_taken, total_retries, and admitted StepRecord.attempts.
change.progress_projection: StepProgressUpdate may retain runner-local counters for diagnostics/API compatibility, but merge_step_progress_updates ignores them and only projects attempt-fenced StepRecord fields.
change.phase_finalize: finalize_phase no longer accepts budget baselines or computes counters from phase GoalRunState.

limitations: Step status still advances in phase GoalRunner and is projected into the durable Team state; full Durable Run Scheduler unification remains unfinished.
No real-model Single-versus-Team paired performance evaluation was run.
